definitions.explanation: The outer or visible side of something.
The outdoors; the public space outside.
The outward appearance shown to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表|おもて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write on the front side of the paper.

examples.japanese: {表|おもて}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I mixed up the front and back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表|おもて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote the name on the front of the envelope.

examples.japanese: {表|おもて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ましょう→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}たち→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{表|おもて}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
{表|おもて}⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: On the surface, he seems fine.
He has a public face and a private face.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表|おもて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}せない→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: This story can't be made public.

notes:
{表|おもて} means 'front,' 'surface,' or 'outside,' contrasting with ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (back).

Common expressions:
- {表|おもて}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧: front and back, both sides
- {表|おもて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go outside; to become public
- {表|おもて}⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧: ostensible, on the surface
- {表|おもて}⟦{通|どお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: main street

Figurative usage:
- {表|おもて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: public face
- {表|おもて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to reveal, to make public

Note: Also read as ひょう in compounds like ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (table/chart) or ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧ (announcement).
